paired_inference.inference_rule: 95 percent hierarchical bootstrap over complete data seeds and paired rounds, with a predeclared 3 percent practical-dominance threshold

mechanism_findings.finding: DuckDB column pruning changes physical work materially.
mechanism_findings.evidence: The key-only aggregate was confidence-authorized as more than 3 percent faster than forced raw materialization in all 12 rows-width-match scenarios. The median key-only/raw-materialized latency ratio ranged from 0.015 to 0.623, and the advantage increased strongly with payload width and matched-row count.

mechanism_findings.finding: Mask cost follows the rows that actually reach Mask, not the logical input table alone.
mechanism_findings.evidence: At 10 percent Join match, post-Join fused Mask was confidence-authorized as faster than pre-Join materialized Mask for output, aggregate, and sorted-output tasks in all 18 corresponding scenarios. Its median latency was 0.093 to 0.134 of the pre-Join route.

mechanism_findings.finding: A pipeline breaker is not uniformly harmful; downstream query shape changes its effect.
mechanism_findings.evidence: For masked row output, post-Join fused execution was faster than or statistically non-dominated with post-Join raw materialization. For masked aggregation, post-Join raw materialization was confidence-authorized as faster than fused in all 12 scenarios; fused/raw-materialized median ratios ranged from 1.773 to 2.525.

mechanism_findings.finding: One fixed physical order cannot represent every legal query family.
mechanism_findings.evidence: The confidence-authorized non-dominated sets differ across match rate, payload width, row count, output, aggregation, and sorting. Point winners alone were not used.

background_workload_disclosure.interpretation: The balanced within-round design and hierarchical paired intervals retain robust mechanism contrasts, but concurrent machine load can affect absolute latency and tail latency.
background_workload_disclosure.required_later_action: After the optimizer and workloads are frozen, run the final headline performance evaluation on an otherwise idle machine. Preserve this run rather than overwriting it.

scientific_boundary: This controlled synthetic EA-0 audit authorizes the candidate-specific physical-work feature representation used to develop the Execution-Aware optimizer. It is not optimizer-performance evidence, not a real-data result, and not evidence of exact per-operator DuckDB payload bytes.
authorized_next_step: Implement and test the frozen Execution-Aware physical-work feature extractor and analytic component-cost interface. Do not fit a residual model until the analytic feature implementation and component microbenchmark calibration protocol are frozen.
